title: Two YAML directives for one document
notes: The second directive is well formed (production 83 admits any directive name), so no character is at fault and no position is stated; section 6.8.1 makes a second YAML directive for the same document an error, even with the same version. The input is that of yaml-test-suite SF5V; this case adds the error category.

provenance.reference: A reader that reported the error at the end of the second directive instead of its start.
